Rooms.Name: Inside a Tavern
Rooms.Description:
You are inside a dimly-lit room. The atmosphere makes you feel
uncomfortable. In front of you stands a mysterious gypsy. She whispers 'Your
fate and destiny lie beyond this world.' You are still wondering what she means
when you suddenly notice the crystal ball ... it glows fiercely and displays
the Universe!

Rooms.Name: Inside the Crystal Ball
Rooms.Description:
You have touched the crystal ball and find that you have gone inside it: a
world of stars and wonders! As you look back you figure out there is no choice
but to go forward.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Galaxy
Rooms.Description:
You are now inside the galaxy, around you you see stars and nebulae smiling
at your presence, and comets and meteors wandering around you. You realize that
this world may not be the true galaxy after all, but just another fantasy zone.
Exits lie virtually in all directions.

Rooms.Name: On an InterGalactic Walkway
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well-paved path which seems that it was made deliberately for
visitors like you. The walkway continues north and a small exit lies west.

Rooms.Name: End of the InterGalactic Walkway
Rooms.Description:
You notice the walkway has come to an abrupt end and you wonder why. You see
that there is still a small path which leads north and one to the west. To the
east lies a bridge.

Rooms.Name: At the Undeveloped Part of the Galaxy
Rooms.Description:
This place looks deserted, covered with space debris. Not a sign of life is
around.

Rooms.Name: On the Bridge of Stars
Rooms.Description:
This bridge has been made by the stars to honour their ancestors. The bridge
itself shines brightly and makes you feel that you are walking on a path of
light. An entrance to an ancient building lies north and to the east lies the
Milky Way.

Rooms.Name: On the Bridge of Nebulae
Rooms.Description:
This bridge, like the other, was made as a memorial. The nebulae had to make
one just to show that they are as capable as the stars. North lies a throne
room.

Rooms.Name: The Throne Room of the Nebula King
Rooms.Description:
You can only faintly make out that it is a throne room as it is too dark in
here. In the middle is an empty throne. You wonder where the King has gone,
maybe he is hiding from you?

Rooms.Name: At the Start of the Milky Way
Rooms.Description:
It is here that the famous old Milky Way starts flowing. You are surrounded
by streams of mist the moment you tread on it. You can't see well in here ...
luckily you haven't fallen yet!

Rooms.Name: Along the Milky Way
Rooms.Description:
You are still travelling inside this path of mist. You notice a small
opening to the east.

Rooms.Name: At the End of the Milky Way
Rooms.Description:
Just as you started enjoying this journey inside the mist, you have come to
the end of it. West leads to a bridge and east leads to somewhere else.

Rooms.Name: A Small Clearing
Rooms.Description:
You are inside a small clearing. You can see that there are signs of a
living creature nearby.

Rooms.Name: An Edge of the Galaxy
Rooms.Description:
You are on the very edge of the galaxy. Nothing is here except that there is
a path which leads down.

Rooms.Name: Very Near to a Gigantic Star
Rooms.Description:
You are very near to a gigantic red star. While you are still fascinated by
its beauty, the star keeps on growing ... suddenly you realize that you'd
better leave.

Rooms.Name: Too Bright to Tell
Rooms.Description:
Indeed it is too bright to tell. Because what you are witnessing is the rare
event of a Supernova, how a star explodes itself into galactic dust. You may
find yourself lucky to witness this rare event but even luckier, you have
finally got out of this galaxy as your body turns into dust. That really HURTS!

Rooms.Name: The Star Cluster
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the home of the stars. All you can see around you are stars
and nothing else. You eyes become pretty hurt as you look at them.

Rooms.Name: Another Edge of the Galaxy
Rooms.Description: This is another uninhabited place. Exits lie north, east and south.

Rooms.Name: Corner of the Galaxy
Rooms.Description:
You wonder why the galaxy is limited. All you have done in Astronomy courses
now prove worthless. Well who told you to take one at the start?

Rooms.Name: Lost in Space
Rooms.Description:
You are now lost in space. Compasses don't work here, sorry. What's more you
can sense darkness engulfing you. You'd better get out quick.

Rooms.Name: Black Hole
Rooms.Description:
Well you have chosen the wrong path, sorry. Nothing can escape from this
monster, not even light. PANIC! You can't escape!

Rooms.Name: The Homes of the Pleiades
Rooms.Description: This is where the famous Seven Sisters live. You'd better not disturb them.

Rooms.Name: Western Side of the Temple
Rooms.Description:
You are still wandering around this temple. You notice exits lie in all
directions except west.

Rooms.Name: Orion's Hunting Lodge
Rooms.Description:
This is dedicated to the Great Hunter of all time -- Orion. Scattered on the
floor is the famous hunting equipment used by him.

Rooms.Name: Northern Side of the Temple
Rooms.Description:
You are still wandering around this temple. You notice exits lie in all
directions except north.

Rooms.Name: The Offering Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This is the sacred offering chamber in which sacrifices are made. You see a
young girl here, chained to the wall, as if she is waiting for execution. You
look up and realize the chains are sent down directly from above. Below you
recognize the temple of Thalos.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance of the Ancient Temple
Rooms.Description:
You have entered into this old temple, which was built originally for the
gods in Mount Olympia, but it is now deserted as someone took over this part of
the Universe.

Rooms.Name: Hercules' Mighty Throne
Rooms.Description:
You stand before the throne of a long-forgotten hero. It is full of bounty
that he got from the Ten Labours.

Rooms.Name: Eastern Side of the Temple
Rooms.Description:
You are still wandering around this temple. You notice exits lie in all
directions except east.

Rooms.Name: Perseus' Chamber
Rooms.Description:
It is the chamber of the prince, Perseus. However, he seems not to be here.
Maybe he has gone to get Pegasus to save Andromeda?

Rooms.Name: On the Mystic Chains
Rooms.Description:
You are dangling on the chains. You notice exits lie in all directions. Up
above you see the chains continue upwards. But a forcefield prevents you from
going further upwards.

Exits.Description: You see the forcefield of Spring.

Rooms.Name: On a Hill
Rooms.Description:
Suddenly you find yourself on a hillside. As you look around, you notice
that Spring has descended upon you.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Spanish Bull-Ring
Rooms.Description:
You are inside what used to be a ground for bull fighting. But you notice
there are no Matadors around. Maybe they are all dead?

Rooms.Name: Inside a study
Rooms.Description:
This is a strange study. Besides the desks and chairs you also see a large
mirror in the middle. So, you wonder, is this how you make a Gemini into two
Gemini?

Rooms.Name: Along the seashore
Rooms.Description:
You start to feel the heat of Summer. Amongst the rocky beach you notice
hidden forms which could be camouflaged crabs.

Rooms.Name: Within the Deep Jungle
Rooms.Description:
Nearby you can hear the roar of an animal. Peering through the dense
overgrowth you think you glimpse a pair of menacing eyes.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Luxurious Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
A peaceful feeling overtakes you. You see a magnificent four-poster bed.
It's a double bed and there is only room for one more! Well, what now ... ?

Rooms.Name: The Supreme Court
Rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the dock of a court. You feel an overwhelming sense
of guilt and you want to protest your innocence! You fear retribution and feel
yourself exposed, just like the trees in Autumn.

Rooms.Name: In the Dry Desert
Rooms.Description:
You are confused by the shifting sands around you. Through the shimmering
heat you see the hazy outline of a giant scorpion ... is this a mirage?

Rooms.Name: In the Woods
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in the center of a Centaurion hunting party. You'd better
hide yourself before you become the 'center attraction'!

Rooms.Name: On a Mountain Peak
Rooms.Description:
You are on the highest peak of the Universe. You look around and notice
clouds below you. One of the clouds resembles a goat-like form.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Waterfall
Rooms.Description:
The noise is deafening. You are about to take a drink when you realize that
the water is being poured out of a vessel of mind-boggling proportions!

Rooms.Name: Inside a Gigantic Clam
Rooms.Description:
You feel uneasy here as if some evil magic is being cast on you. You suspect
something fishy is going on in here.

Rooms.Name: End of the Mystic Chains
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the end of the mystic chains. Looking up, you notice a
small landing on which you can climb. However, there seems to be another
forcefield blocking your way.

Exits.Description: You see the forcefield of Summer.
You see the forcefield of Spring.

Rooms.Name: On the Draco
Rooms.Description:
You realize you are standing on scaly ground. As you wonder what the ground
is made of, you feel the ground move.

Rooms.Name: Tail of the Draco
Rooms.Description:
At last you realize that you are on a giant snake-like dragon called the
Draco, the guardian of the inner galaxy. You realize that the Draco is actually
flying now!

Rooms.Name: Path of the Draco
Rooms.Description:
As you struggle along this scaly creature you realize that the only way you
can reach to the inner galaxy is by going all the way to the head.

Rooms.Name: Near the Legs of Draco
Rooms.Description:
You are approaching the leg part of this creature. You look around and see
that the surrounding is all dark except for some faint lights from the distant
stars.

Rooms.Name: On the Back of Draco
Rooms.Description:
At last you are half way through this long, weary journey. You can see the
wings are to the east but it seems that another forcefield is in the way.

Exits.Description: You see the forcefield of Autumn.

Rooms.Name: Between the Wings of Draco
Rooms.Description:
You hear some giant flapping sounds nearby. You desperately try to get hold
of something as the forceful gusts sweep you away.

Rooms.Name: Near the Arms of Draco
Rooms.Description:
From above you can faintly make out the gigantic arms which extend far
beyond into the darkness.

Rooms.Name: On the Neck of Draco
Rooms.Description:
Your journey is now approaching the end. However, this neck seems to be
endless.

Rooms.Name: Approaching the Head of Draco
Rooms.Description:
You have come to the end of Draco, but you can't find the head! You see a
forcefield to the south, some distance away, beyond reach. If only the head
were here ...

Exits.Description: You see the forcefield of Winter.

Rooms.Name: At the Entrance of the Great Dipper
Rooms.Description:
Now you are in the innermost part of the galaxy. What you are walking on now
is the path of the Great Dipper or the Plough. You notice that there are seven
rooms in this zone, representing the seven stars of the Dipper.

Exits.Description: You see the forcefield of Winter.

Rooms.Name: Cassiopeia's Throne
Rooms.Description:
This is the Throne room of the Queen of the Universe. From here you can see
every star and constellation in the Universe.

Rooms.Name: Along the Path of the Dipper
Rooms.Description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

Rooms.Name: Cepheus' Throne
Rooms.Description:
This is the Throne room of the King of the Universe. From here you can see
every star and constellation in the Universe.

Rooms.Name: Along the path of the Dipper
Rooms.Description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

Rooms.Name: Along the path of the Dipper
Rooms.Description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

Rooms.Name: End of the Dipper
Rooms.Description:
You have finished the path of the Dipper. Here, the most prominent feature
is a set of claw-marks. You also notice a room to the south; it looks as if
Polaris could lie here.

Rooms.Name: The Polar Star
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the private chamber of Polaris. This is a room of great
significance. You can see a powerful telescope pointing down towards the
Universe (SNOOPING!). It is from here that Polaris commands the Universe. You
feel you have come to end of your search in this galaxy ...

Mobs.Name: poor mudder
Mobs.LongDescription: A poor mudder, lost in this place.
Mobs.Description: You will become her if you are not careful.

Mobs.Name: star
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful white star smiles at you.
Mobs.Description: You can't tell what the star looks like, it is too bright!

Mobs.Name: nebula young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young nebula, waiting to become a star.
Mobs.Description: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.

Mobs.Name: comet speedy
Mobs.LongDescription: A speedy comet is waiting to crush your head in.
Mobs.Description: You see the offspring of Halley's comet, here just to wipe everything out.

Mobs.Name: red supergiant
Mobs.LongDescription: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
Mobs.Description:
You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds ...
Still he can be very powerful.

Mobs.Name: white dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A tiny white dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
Mobs.Description:
Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy.
But somehow he manages to escape.  Though tiny, it can take a lot of hits!

Mobs.Name: horsehead nebula
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge nebula is here, resembling a horsehead.
Mobs.Description:
You can only make out its shape from the darkness.  He was cursed to stay in
here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.

Mobs.Name: andromeda
Mobs.LongDescription: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering ...
Mobs.Description:
She was once a princess of beauty.  However, her beauty has led to a Goddess's
jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly until Perseus comes.
